# FileMakr
> Final-year project reports, runnable source code, live demos and student guides for B.Tech, BCA, MCA, BE, ME, BSc and MSc.

## Canonical URL patterns
- Home: https://www.filemakr.com/
- Source code catalog: https://www.filemakr.com/source-code
- Source code detail: https://www.filemakr.com/{seo_name}/source-code
- Project report detail: https://www.filemakr.com/{seo_name}-report
- Degree-specific report: https://www.filemakr.com/{seo_name}-report-{degree}
  (degree: btech, mtech, be, me, bca, mca, bsc, msc)
- Degree report catalogs: https://www.filemakr.com/{degree}-final-year-project-report
- Blog: https://www.filemakr.com/blog
- Blog article: https://www.filemakr.com/blog/{slug}
- Live demos: https://www.filemakr.com/demo
